title: Lost Mary Maryliq x Crystal Blueberry Sour Raspberry 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid - 20mg
description: Maryliq x Crystal Blueberry Sour Raspberry by Lost Mary presents a refined take on one of the vaping world’s most iconic flavour profiles. Part of the exclusive Maryliq x Crystal series, this blend revisits the classic recipe to deliver a taste experience with superior definition and intensity. The inhale brings a wave of sweet, jammy blueberry notes, rich and ripe. This is immediately contrasted by a sharp, tangy raspberry finish on the exhale that adds a vibrant sour kick. Formulated with a balanced 50% VG / 50% PG ratio, this nic salt e-liquid offers the perfect equilibrium between flavour clarity and discreet vapour production. It is designed for seamless performance in low-powered MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) pod kits and starter pens. The 20mg nicotine salt formulation ensures a silky-smooth throat hit and rapid satisfaction, making this an ideal choice for vapers seeking a bold, dual-fruit vape with a premium edge.
